card.name: Decimal point inside a number
card.fires_on: The period (or comma) right after the whole-number part of a figure, before the decimal digits. Seen in lab limits, percentages, section references and measurements.

modes.label: Decimal point in results
modes.description: A period after two digits in a percentage, range or lab limit.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: A period inside a numbered section reference in brackets.

modes.label: Thousands comma
modes.description: A comma after the first digits of a large number.
